verses.text: Brethren, even if a man be overtaken in any trespass, ye who are spiritual, restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness; looking to thyself, lest thou also be tempted.

segments.text: Brethren, even if a man be overtaken in any trespass, ye who are spiritual, restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness; looking to thyself, lest thou also be tempted.

verses.text: Bear ye one another’s burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.

segments.text: Bear ye one another’s burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.

verses.text: For if a man thinketh himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.

segments.text: For if a man thinketh himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.

verses.text: But let each man prove his own work, and then shall he have his glorying in regard of himself alone, and not of his neighbor.

segments.text: But let each man prove his own work, and then shall he have his glorying in regard of himself alone, and not of his neighbor.

verses.text: For each man shall bear his own burden.

segments.text: For each man shall bear his own burden.

verses.text: But let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teacheth in all good things.

segments.text: But let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teacheth in all good things.

verses.text: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.

segments.text: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.

verses.text: For he that soweth unto his own flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that soweth unto the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap eternal life.

segments.text: For he that soweth unto his own flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that soweth unto the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap eternal life.

verses.text: And let us not be weary in well-doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.

segments.text: And let us not be weary in well-doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.

verses.text: So then, as we have opportunity, let us work that which is good toward all men, and especially toward them that are of the household of the faith.

segments.text: So then, as we have opportunity, let us work that which is good toward all men, and especially toward them that are of the household of the faith.

verses.text: See with how large letters I write unto you with mine own hand.

segments.text: See with how large letters I write unto you with mine own hand.

verses.text: As many as desire to make a fair show in the flesh, they compel you to be circumcised; only that they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.

segments.text: As many as desire to make a fair show in the flesh, they compel you to be circumcised; only that they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.

verses.text: For not even they who receive circumcision do themselves keep the law; but they desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.

segments.text: For not even they who receive circumcision do themselves keep the law; but they desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.

verses.text: But far be it from me to glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world hath been crucified unto me, and I unto the world.

segments.text: But far be it from me to glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world hath been crucified unto me, and I unto the world.

verses.text: For neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.

segments.text: For neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.

verses.text: And as many as shall walk by this rule, peace be upon them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.

segments.text: And as many as shall walk by this rule, peace
be
upon them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.

verses.text: Henceforth let no man trouble me; for I bear branded on my body the marks of Jesus.

segments.text: Henceforth let no man trouble me; for I bear branded on my body the marks of Jesus.

verses.text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brethren. Amen.

segments.text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brethren. Amen.
